newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel rangebound, no Russian news.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel rangebound, no Russian news.

text.p: Eyes and ears fixed on Russia awaiting a tariff levy on straight-run exports on Friday were disappointed. No announcement was made and the market must wait over the weekend.

Up to five E-4 cargoes are set to load next week, with at least one probably destined to the U.S. with prices unchanged in the low $130s cif NWE. Low sulphur slipped with crude with supplies from West Africa threatening to overhang NWE.
"It could go to the U.S, but I don't think the numbers are high enough there," said one trader. Buyers were looking for low $140s fob, but at least one seller with tank material wanted $150 fob.
